description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, providing improved performance, security patches, new language features, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK/Java version to 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all source compatibility settings, compiler plugins, and toolchain configurations reference Java 25. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded Java version from 21 to 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property and Dockerfile base images (build: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-25, runtime: eclipse-temurin:25-jre-alpine). Build verified successfully with JDK 25.0.3 — 22 source files compiled cleanly. No CVEs detected in direct dependencies.
